// scope: Hierarchical assembly (HANDOFF.md T4.2), not a flat run: sonic_tile/sonic_router/sonic_sram_bank are consumed as pre-hardened macros (GDS+LEF+LIB+blackbox netlist from their own p4/openlane/{tile,router,sram} block runs) and instanced via MACROS, not re-synthesized here. This is why N_TILES=4 and N_SRAM_BANKS=4 are now affordable when the flat p4/openlane/top/config.json had to pin both to 1 -- macro instancing doesn't re-run ABC on tile/router/sram_bank's internals, it just places+routes finished blocks plus the (much smaller) glue logic (seq/streamer/conv/softmax/lmhead/vec/sram_gate/mbist/rv32/noc/ioring) that VERILOG_FILES still lists. T=8/LANES=4/SEGS=8/ADDR_WIDTH=8 are NOT independent choices here -- they must match whatever the tile/router/sram block runs actually hardened, because a macro's internal parameterization is baked into its GDS/LEF and cannot be changed at the top level.
// prereqs: This config will not run yet. Three artifact classes referenced under MACROS do not exist in this repo today and must be produced before `nix run github:librelane/librelane -- config.json` here can succeed: (1) GDS -- none of the three block runs vendor their GDS in this repo (deliberately, per HANDOFF_TOP_RUN.md's own convention -- 113MB+ each); pull it from wherever the original run's runs/<tag>/final/gds/ landed, or re-run p4-tile/p4-router/p4-sram and keep the GDS this time. (2) LEF -- same story, needed from final/lef/ of those same runs; LibreLane's own flow with MACROS declared always emits LEF+GDS+lib+nl for that run so a *future* p4-tile/p4-router/p4-sram invocation should already produce everything needed as long as its config.json isn't changed (T=8/LANES=4/SEGS=8/ADDR_WIDTH=8 stay as-is). (3) sonic_router has NO committed .lib at any corner (only tile and sram do -- compare p4/openlane/{tile,sram}/results/*/lib/ against router/results/segs8/, which has none). Without a router .lib, top-level STA cannot time paths through the router macro at all; re-run p4-router (unchanged config) and this time copy runs/<tag>/final/lib/ into router/results/segs8/lib/, mirroring the tile/sram layout exactly (paths above assume that layout).
// counts: N_TILES=4 and N_SRAM_BANKS=4 are a first hierarchical step, not the shipping counts (4 is already the shipping tile count; SRAM is 4 of the shipping 16 banks). Going from 1 to multiple instances of an *already-hardened* macro is the actual thing this run needs to prove that the flat run (N_TILES=1, N_SRAM_BANKS=1) could not -- multi-macro placement, routing between macro halos, and PDN reaching across them. Raising N_SRAM_BANKS to the shipping 16 is an easy follow-on once this floorplan closes (add rows to the MACROS.sonic_sram_bank.instances object and widen DIE_AREA), same idea as router's config-next.json tightening after config.json's segs8 baseline. Do not raise it before a first hierarchical run establishes a baseline, per the same lesson every block run in this repo already learned about tightening parameters before a first pass exists.
// floorplan: DIE_AREA/CORE_AREA and every MACROS.*.instances location are derived in p4/openlane/top-hier/macro_placement.cfg (kept as a human-readable cross-check, not consumed by the flow -- this config.json is the single source of truth LibreLane actually reads). Update both files together.
// glue: The un-hardened blocks (seq/streamer/conv/softmax/lmhead/vec/sram_gate/mbist/rv32/noc/ioring) still synthesize as flat std-cell logic in VERILOG_FILES, same as the flat top run -- this hierarchical config only pulls tile/router/sram_bank out of that set because those are the only three blocks with a finished, independently-hardened result to instance as a macro (HANDOFF.md T4.1). sonic_acc.sv/sonic_pe.sv are intentionally absent from VERILOG_FILES here -- they're internal to sonic_tile and are already compiled into the tile macro, listing them again would double-declare those modules against the macro's blackbox view.
// phy: sonic_phy_lpddr5x.sv is listed but not instantiated by sonic_top.sv, same as the flat run's config.json -- see that file's own "// phy" comment for why (hardened commercial macro dropped in outside this flow, not synthesizable on Sky130).
// clock: 1500 ns reused verbatim from the flat top/router runs -- this is a flow-qualification clock (lets the resizer finish and the flow reach routing), not a frequency claim; see p4/openlane/top/config.json's own "// clock" comment.
// keys: LibreLane errors on unrecognised config keys. Only keys beginning with // are exempt, which is why the comments look like this.
